description.zh: 将 featureCounts 插件生成的 clean.count.txt（仅含 Geneid 与样本计数）转换为标准化的 FPKM 与 TPM 表达矩阵。通过 GTF/GFF 注释文件自动计算每个基因的外显子合并长度，无需额外的长度文件。适用于跨样本表达量比较及下游可视化。
description.en: Convert the featureCounts clean.count.txt (Geneid + sample counts only) into normalized FPKM and TPM matrices. Gene lengths are computed automatically from a GTF/GFF annotation (merged exon length), no separate length file needed.

description.zh: featureCounts 插件输出的 clean.count.txt，第一列为基因 ID，其余列为各样本原始计数。
description.en: The clean.count.txt from the featureCounts plugin: first column = gene IDs, remaining columns = raw sample counts.

description.zh: 用于计算基因长度（合并外显子长度）。建议使用与 featureCounts 定量时相同的注释文件。
description.en: Used to compute gene length (merged exon length). Use the same annotation as the featureCounts step.

description.zh: GTF 属性中表示基因 ID 的键名，通常为 gene_id（GTF）或 ID/gene（GFF3）。
description.en: GTF attribute key for gene ID, usually gene_id (GTF) or ID/gene (GFF3).

description.zh: 输出文件名前缀，默认 gene
description.en: Output file name prefix (default: gene)

description.zh: Fragments Per Kilobase of transcript per Million mapped reads 标准化矩阵
description.en: FPKM normalized expression matrix

description.zh: Transcripts Per Million 标准化矩阵（推荐用于跨样本比较）
description.en: TPM normalized expression matrix (recommended for cross-sample comparison)

description.zh: 基于差异分析结果绘制基因表达变化排序图（颜色映射 P 值，点大小映射 Log2FoldChange 绝对值）。
description.en: Draw ranked differential-expression curve from DE results (color mapped to P-value and point size mapped to absolute log2 fold change).

description.zh: P值越小（越显著）显示的颜色
description.en: Color for small (significant) P-values

description.zh: P值中间范围显示的颜色
description.en: Color for mid-range P-values

description.zh: P值越大（越不显著）显示的颜色
description.en: Color for large (non-significant) P-values

description.zh: P值颜色条最小值，低于此值截断显示为显著色
description.en: P-value color bar minimum; values below are clamped

description.zh: P值颜色条最大值，高于此值截断显示为不显著色
description.en: P-value color bar maximum; values above are clamped

description.zh: P值颜色条刻度步进值
description.en: P-value legend tick step

description.zh: 输入要标记的基因名，多个用逗号分隔
description.en: Gene names to mark, separated by commas

description.zh: 从 NCBI 官方 AWS 公共桶固定分片高速下载完整质量 SRA，再用 fasterq-dump 与 pigz 本地生成成对 FASTQ；FASTQ 与 SRA 缓存均采用无子目录的扁平布局，并支持断点、速度/ETA、自动重试和完整性校验。
description.en: Downloads full-quality SRA objects from the official NCBI AWS public bucket with resumable ranges, then generates paired FASTQ locally with fasterq-dump and pigz. FASTQ and SRA cache files use flat layouts with progress, retries, and integrity checks.

metadata.tool_version: NCBI SRA Toolkit 3.4.1 / fixed-range downloader / pigz 2.8

description.en: For example, ERR1314950.

description.zh: 支持逗号、空格或换行分隔。
description.en: Separate accessions with commas, spaces, or new lines.

description.zh: 同一 SRA 对象的固定分片并行连接数；高速通道默认 8，网络拥塞时可降为 4 或 2。
description.en: Parallel fixed-range connections for one SRA object; the high-speed default is 8, or reduce to 4 or 2 on congested links.

description.zh: 供 fasterq-dump 和 pigz 使用；默认 12。
description.en: Used by fasterq-dump and pigz; defaults to 12.

description.zh: 每个固定分片独立重试并从已写入字节续传；完整性失败会清除错误分片。
description.en: Each fixed range retries independently from its written bytes; integrity failures remove bad ranges.

description.zh: 要求 fasterq-dump 生成且仅生成 _1/_2 两个 FASTQ。
description.en: Require fasterq-dump to produce exactly _1/_2 FASTQ files.

description.zh: 默认保留已校验 SRA，并直接放在 .s3_sra_cache 根目录。
description.en: Keep validated SRA files by default directly in the .s3_sra_cache root.

metadata.command_template: export input_type='{input_type}' accession='{accession}' accession_text='{accession_text}' accession_file={accession_file} download_connections='{download_connections}' threads='{threads}' retry_count='{retry_count}' require_paired='{require_paired}' keep_sra_cache='{keep_sra_cache}' output_dir='{output_dir}'; tr -d '\r' < /scripts/scripts/run_s3_fastq.sh > /tmp/run_s3_fastq.sh && exec sh /tmp/run_s3_fastq.sh
